name: replicaguard
description: ReplicaGuard: Self-Healing Distributed File Storage System

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/storage-node && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/coordinator && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/storage-node && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/coordinator && npm run build --workspace=@replicaguard/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "coordinator,node-1,node-2,node-3,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/coordinator" "cross-env NODE_ID=node-1 PORT=4101 STORAGE_DIR=storage/server1 npm run dev --workspace=packages/storage-node" "cross-env NODE_ID=node-2 PORT=4102 STORAGE_DIR=storage/server2 npm run dev --workspace=packages/storage-node" "cross-env NODE_ID=node-3 PORT=4103 STORAGE_DIR=storage/server3 npm run dev --workspace=packages/storage-node" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/web"
scripts.dev:spare: cross-env NODE_ID=node-4 PORT=4104 STORAGE_DIR=storage/server4 npm run dev --workspace=packages/storage-node
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rimraf storage/node-1 storage/node-2 storage/node-3 storage/node-4
